title1.text: Wavee Home Redesign, native pass. Everything inside the content layer is now a stock WinUI 3 surface: the daylist is a card on the layer with its header image inset (no scrim banner), shelves are GridView/ListView item templates with big 4px-radius covers, and each shelf gets a different template (row items, a wide lead plus squares, 16:9 tiles, grouped lists, circles, navigation tiles). Buttons are 32px WinUI controls, text never goes below 12px, and nothing lifts. The real Wavee Mica shell is unchanged.

datasources.text:
DATA SOURCES by zone

Shell (title bar / icon rail / now-playing): existing Wavee app chrome, drawn as real context

0 · Facet control (All / Music / Podcasts / Audiobooks, + Following): home response homeChips (Music and Podcasts carry a Following sub-chip, Audiobooks none); All is the app's own no-facet position. Every facet is its own home document: HomeQuery(facet) with music-chip / podcasts-chip / audiobooks-chip / *-following-chip, cached per facet id under wavee:home:<facet>

1 · Daylist card: home response (daylist section + greeting 'Good morning') + extended metadata (header_image_url_desktop, description tag links, PlaylistItemsPage.totalCount '50 songs', next-update time for the live countdown + daypart fill; the 07:04–13:04 window is illustrative)

2 · Recently played (4×2 row items): Recents (RecentsEdge order, playedAtMs → 'yesterday'/'Monday', entity type; Liked Songs count from library, illustrative). The now-playing marker comes from Connect state

3 · Made for you: home response ('Made For Chris' Daily Mixes 1,3–6 + 'Soundtrack your Friday morning' moods, page 2). Wide lead Discover Weekly uses its header_image_url_desktop + totalCount. DJ excluded

4 · It's New Music Friday!: home response section 1. 16:9 tiles use header_image_url_desktop + totalCount for the six items that have one. 'From artists you follow' uses the followed-artists releases endpoint (type, date, track count; illustrative values)

5 · Because you like…: home response (HomeFeedBaselineSectionData 'More like X' / 'For fans of X'), clustered client-side by entity, max 3 rows per card

6 · Jump back in: home response (curated shelf + Shorts section), 2 pages

7 · Radio & mixes: home response (Recommended Stations + Popular radio + Your top mixes + 'Made for you' baseline mixes, deduped). Wide lead Savage Garden Radio uses its header image

8 · Browse: home response ('Officiële Spotify playlists' + New Music Friday editorial items without header images). Charts: browse (Top 50 NL / Global, Viral 50 NL) as navigation tiles only; no chart tracks were captured, so none are drawn

MUSIC board (home_filtered.json, 'Good afternoon', 29 sections): M1 'Made For Chris' (Daily Mixes 1–6; Discover Weekly as the lead via its header_image_url_desktop; DJ dropped, not supported) · M2 'Soundtrack your Friday afternoon' (the daylist as a plain square + mood mixes, first sentence of each description) · M3 'More like Avril Lavigne' (stations/artists round). No Recents, Jump back in or daylist hero: they aren't in the Music response and are never borrowed from All

PODCASTS board (podcasts.json, Fri 25 Sep 2026, 31 sections regrouped into 8 zones): P1 New episodes ('New episode from {show}' singles, newest first; lead = newest with a 1280×720 videoPreviewThumbnail) · P2 Continue listening (playedState IN_PROGRESS + playPositionMilliseconds → '44 min left' and the hairline; then 'Catch up on your shows') · P3 Your shows (verbatim) · P4 Videos you might like (topped up with VIDEO episodes) · P5 Episodes you might like ('Similar to your interests' + 'Episodes you might like', deduped by uri and by name+date) · P6 Because you listen to… ('Popular with listeners of X' / 'More like {episode}' groups; a shows shelf with the same key becomes the footer strip) · P7 Shows you might like · P8 Popular with listeners of SOLVED with Mark Manson. Dates are relative to the capture day; durations from duration.totalMilliseconds; the video glyph from mediaTypes ∋ VIDEO; the E badge from contentRating / contentRatingV2 EXPLICIT. Episode lookups refresh playedState before a Play; they never block the reveal. Not in the data, so not drawn: per-show unplayed counts, latest-episode dates, podcast categories

AUDIOBOOKS (States panel 3): no capture and no activity → the starter. FACET SWITCH board: states of the switch, no data of its own

rationale.text:
WHY IT FEELS NATIVE NOW (research: 05-native-research.md)

• Layering: Mica base, content layer, 8px cards on it. Imagery sits inside cards; text stays on the layer
• Geometry 8 / 4 / 0: cards 8, covers/buttons/rows 4, no pills (except the round media play)
• Windows type ramp only: 12 / 14 / 20 / 28 / 40, Regular + Semibold, sentence case
• Stock controls: Accent / Standard / Subtle buttons, HyperlinkButton 'See all', PipsPager, SettingsCard-style tiles
• GridView templates: image + text below (1:1, 16:9) and a two-cell wide lead, like the Store and Xbox apps
• Hover = fill change, press = lower fill; no lift, no glow. Arrow cursor on buttons. Two-tone focus rectangle
• Rhythm: no two neighbouring shelves share a template

facetflow.text:
FACET DATA FLOW. One home document per facet id ("" for All, music-chip, podcasts-chip, audiobooks-chip, *-following-chip). A switch keeps the old page, dims it to .6 with no hit-testing, and pins a 3px indeterminate ProgressBar under the control (the rest row, or the sticky band when scrolled). On arrival: 83ms out, 250ms in, 30ms zone stagger. On failure: the pivot reverts and an InfoBar with Retry appears; the old content stays. Cached (≤10 min): instant swap. Stale: instant + a silent refresh (bar, no dim). Skeleton only on the first-ever load. Prefetch on 150ms hover or on focus. Following = the sub-chip id used as the facet. State is per tab; each switch pushes a history entry; scroll is kept per facet.

MAIN IS INTERACTIVE: click Music, Podcasts or Audiobooks (or All) to run the real sequence: about 1.2s dimmed under the bar, then the swap. Podcasts → Following loads the Following page (P1–P3 only). Music → Following plays the failure path, because no Music-Following capture exists. The "scroll" tweak shows the compact band with the page scrolled 616px.
